title: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: Suppose you have taken part in a career planning seminar. Write an account of the seminar and summarize what you have learned from it. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: Last week, our university held a career planning seminar in the lecture hall, which attracted a large number of students who are about to face job hunting. The lecture was delivered by an experienced human resources manager, who has helped many graduates find suitable jobs. During the seminar, the speaker focused on how to plan a career and pointed out that many graduates feel lost simply because they have never planned ahead. He suggested that we should first recognize our own interests and strengths, then set clear and realistic goals, and finally start to build up relevant skills as early as possible. What impressed me most was a real story about a student who got an ideal offer through years of careful preparation. This seminar made me realize that career planning should never be put off until graduation. From now on, I will think seriously about what I really want and take small steps toward my goals instead of drifting along. After all, a well-planned future begins with action today.
keyPoints: 背景段一次交代要素。用 "Last week, our university held a career planning seminar...which attracted..." 套用了第一段"时间地点开篇句架"，一句话讲清时间、地点、活动与听众； 再用 "The lecture was delivered by an experienced human resources manager" 引出主讲人，完成 an account of the seminar 的背景交代。
主题句＋三步建议＋最深印象。"the speaker focused on...and pointed out that..." 是概括 主题句，"He suggested that we should first...then...and finally..." 分点列出讲座建议，"What impressed me most was..." 突出印象最深处，既概括又有重点，避免了流水账。

由讲座转出具体收获。"This seminar made me realize that..." 用过渡句把镜头转向自 己，"From now on, I will...instead of..." 落下具体启示，结尾 "a well-planned future begins with action today" 收口，完成 summarize what you have learned from it。
